name: Organizational Culture Assessment Instrument (OCAI)
description: A 24-item survey based on the Competing Values Framework measuring current and preferred culture across four quadrants: Clan, Adhocracy, Market, and Hierarchy.
reputation: Most widely used culture assessment; free versions available; academic and practitioner use.
notes: Self-report; ipsative format (forced distribution) affects factor analysis; free online versions vary in quality.
